journal: Journal of Molecular Graphics and Modelling

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: Computational molecular structure/interaction work is within the broad scope, but the publisher excludes routine methods without genuine new insight. This is a narrow deposited-coordinate reanalysis, not a demonstrated accepted contribution.
checks.unchecked_requirements: Exact eligible article category and editorial sufficiency remain unchecked.

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: No numeric word, abstract, title, keyword, highlight, reference, table or figure limits are certified.
checks.unchecked_requirements: Article-type limits, mandatory headings, structured abstract, highlights and graphical abstract requirements.

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: General AI policy gives human accountability/authorship and disclosure obligations; author-owned facts remain unresolved.
checks.unchecked_requirements: JMGM title-page fields, CRediT format, funding/COI forms, approvals, acknowledgments/permissions and declaration placement.

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: Official scope emphasizes reproducibility and encourages machine-readable supplementary datasets. This is not proof of a mandatory repository or licensing rule.
checks.unchecked_requirements: Mandatory availability statement, repository/deposit rules, code/software citation, review anonymization, embargo and supplement limits.

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: Current publisher policy distinguishes explanatory images, data visualizations and primary research images. Reproducible data-derived AI-assisted visualization is permitted with Methods disclosure; explanatory images need caption plus general disclosure. Do not invent underlying data or primary research images. Formal AI-based research methods must be reproducibly described in Methods. General-purpose generative-AI image tools must not create graphical abstracts; AI-generated cover art requires prior journal editor/publisher permission.
checks.unchecked_requirements: JMGM-specific file type, resolution, dimensions, color/accessibility, graphical-abstract and rights/permission requirements.

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: Disclose tool, purpose and oversight for substantive manuscript assistance; research-process use belongs in Methods. AI is not an author. Basic spelling/grammar-only checks are exempt, but this assistance goes beyond that.
checks.unchecked_requirements: Author-approved complete tool/version/assistance history and exact JMGM statement placement/portal fields.

checks.verified_or_bounded_note: No submission, account/portal action, cover letter or final declaration prepared.
checks.unchecked_requirements: Current portal, blinded versus unblinded files, article category, reviewer/exclusion fields, submission forms, prior-publication declarations, exclusivity, revision requirements and any fees/open-access choices.
